_about: Monochrome Cinema variant from Top-100 rank 5 (r21, snippco, Jim Rohn motivational, score 9). The darkest, starkest member of the family: pure WHITE type (no colour accent), tight bold sans small words on one line, bold-italic sans or serif-italic hero, frequent black word cards one word at a time ('why... not... you?'), B&W metaphor cutaways (MRI brain, running silhouette) and teal-tinted motion-blur crowds. Measured: picture change 1.06 s (56 changes/min), caption every 0.85 s, captions ~50% down, face 28% down / 25% of frame (wide stage shot), luma 41.6, sat 86, -16.8 LUFS, LRA 2.3.

monochrome.tealGrade: grayscale(0.6) sepia(0.3) hue-rotate(140deg) saturate(1.4) contrast(1.15) brightness(0.66)

director.style: Monochrome Cinema (stark white): darker, starker and faster than the family. All type white, no colour accent. Word cards carry the questions.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase; most phrases have no hero (heroFallback none) and run as one small white line. captions.serif: the 1-2 'plan/decision' words in serif italic. Lowercase.
director.wordcards: At most 3 black wordpage scenes per reel, ONLY on payoff words followed by a pause (a sentence or clause end), never back to back (>= 2.5 s apart), 0.75 s minimum; the card starts after the previous word so it never overprints it. (Hardened 9 Oct: 'we' was a weak card.)
director.cutaways: 3-4 image scenes per 20 s, captions: true, 0.8-2.0 s, from the VETTED pool only (public domain / CC0, no people, no text, no religious or political landmarks, no brands; licence logged per reel). Alternate monochrome.cutawayGrade and monochrome.tealGrade; teal only on warm or neutral stills.
director.rhythm: Picture changes every ~1.1 s (cards and cutaways count). Return to the speaker between cutaways. Hard cuts only.
director.structure: Hardened 9 Oct: the speaker carries the opening line (~2-3 s) and the last ~1.5-2 s (the reel ends on the speaker at a sentence end, never mid-dissolve); between them cutaways and cards butt with a 0.22 s blur-in on TOP of the previous picture (no double exposure through the face). Only the speaker->cutaway and cutaway->speaker joins are a short blur (0.18-0.22 s). Generated by ~/reels/mc-harden/plan_mc.py.
director.sound: Like the ref (demucs 7 Oct): an emotional keys bed LOUD, only ~6 dB under the voice (music alif-match-d, closest match 5.9), and a few soft 1-1.5 kHz whooshes only on the word cards (inSfx whoosh-3 / whoosh-cine); no caption whooshes.
